title: A complete MCP run: four gates passed
narration: My agent used M-C-P and Falkor-D-B to launch real robot training. The run passed four validation gates.

title: The agent launches training
narration: It chooses a starting checkpoint and calls start training. The guardrail approves the evidence and budget before the worker starts.

title: FalkorDB connects the evidence
narration: Falkor-D-B connects policies, training runs, trials, evaluations, failures and decisions. The links preserve what produced what.

title: A shortest path through real lineage
narration: The shortest-path tool runs inside Falkor-D-B. It returned the nearest passing ancestor, one hop away. The agent considered it alongside seventeen eligible origins.

title: The guardrail can veto the agent
narration: Contracts tie a checkpoint to sensor and action meanings. The guardrail vetoes incompatible origins, stale hashes, incomplete validation, or unsupported budgets.

title: The Decision precedes the action
narration: Before training, the Decision saves the model, tool calls, Cypher, parameters and returned records. If Falkor-D-B is unavailable, planning stops.

title: Real PPO, then saved-policy evaluation
narration: The worker trained sixty-one thousand, four hundred forty P-P-O steps, then reloaded the checkpoint for one hundred eighty validation episodes.

title: Four suites. The same fixed gate.
narration: All four suites passed the unchanged gate. Target collisions were three in sixty. Open had zero; static and crossing had one each in forty.

title: Target and crossing regressed
narration: But the parent had two target collisions and no crossing collisions. Both measures got worse. Passing the gate does not establish an improvement, so I kept the demo policy unchanged.

title: Earlier results remain frozen
narration: The earlier failure stays visible: thirteen target collisions in one hundred held-out episodes. The separate confirmed checkpoint still has eight in one hundred.

title: Separate MuJoCo transfer evidence
narration: That confirmed two-dimensional checkpoint also collided six times in forty MuJoCo target episodes, without retraining. This is a separate transfer study.

title: Every result has its evidence
narration: The graph and checksummed evidence make these results inspectable. EmbodiWeave. Built on Falkor-D-B.
